title: MAT Filter Common Page
summary: Official Derivative MAT Filter Common page reference for common render-state parameters on filter-style MATs, including blending, depth test/write, alpha test, wire frame, cull face, and polygon depth offset.
guidance: Use this article when a filter-style material exposes the common MAT render-state page and needs parameter-level grounding.
The filter common page covers the shared render states but does not include the generator-only blend operation and constant-color blend options.
Use depthtest/depthfunc/depthwriting together when diagnosing occlusion or depth-buffer surprises.
Use alphatest/alphafunc/alphathreshold for cutout-style alpha discard.
Cull Face can optimize rendering or remove artifacts; options include userender, neither, backfaces, frontfaces, and bothfaces.
